title: GreySkull LP (Phrak's) – Workout B
creator: John Sheaffer (GreySkull); variant by u/Phrakture
description: John Sheaffer's GreySkull LP in Phrak's popular variant, which adds a pull to every session: two sets of five then an AMRAP set on each lift, three days a week alternating A and B (A/B/A, then B/A/B). Add 1 kg (2.5 lb) to upper lifts and 2.5 kg (5 lb) to squat/deadlift each session; if the AMRAP set hits 10+ reps double the jump; if it falls under 5 reps take 10% off that lift and build back. The base programme instead pairs bench+squat (A) and press+deadlift (B) with curls, chins and neck work.
